items.question: How much does it cost to rent an electric wheelchair in Malaysia?
items.answer: Our electric wheelchair rental starts from RM400 per month. No credit card is required — you can pay via online banking. Rental includes delivery, setup, and a demonstration on how to use the wheelchair.

items.question: Can I buy an electric wheelchair instead of renting?
items.answer: Yes! Our electric wheelchairs are available for purchase starting from RM2,400. All purchases come with a 6-month warranty covering the motor, battery, and frame. We also offer installment plans at RM400/month for 12 months.

items.question: How fast is delivery?
items.answer: We offer same-day delivery for orders placed before 2pm within Peninsular Malaysia. East Malaysia (Sabah & Sarawak) delivery takes 2-3 business days. All deliveries include free setup and demonstration.

items.question: Are your electric wheelchairs KKM certified?
items.answer: Yes, all our electric wheelchairs are certified by Malaysia's Ministry of Health (KKM). This ensures they meet safety and quality standards for medical mobility devices.

items.question: Do you offer wheelchair repair services?
items.answer: Yes, we provide full repair services for all electric wheelchair brands. We stock genuine spare parts including batteries, motors, joystick controllers, and tyres. Contact us via WhatsApp for repair pricing.

items.question: What is the weight capacity of your electric wheelchairs?
items.answer: Our standard lightweight models support up to 100kg. For larger users, our heavy-duty model supports up to 120kg with a reinforced steel frame. All models are foldable and fit in most car boots.

A lightweight chair that folds into a car boot matters here more than anywhere, because the day is spent between home, clinic and mall.

regionIntro.negeriSembilan: From {city}, Seremban and the highway are close, which keeps Negeri Sembilan inside our same-day delivery run. Families here often rent first for a recovery period and buy later once the chair has proved itself on the daily routine.
regionIntro.melaka: {city} and the rest of Melaka are a straightforward run down the highway from us, so orders placed before 2pm arrive the same day. The compact frame suits the older shophouses and narrow lanes that make up so much of the state.
regionIntro.johor: Johor is our largest delivery area outside the Klang Valley, and {city} is part of the same-day route. The foldable chair travels well — useful for families who cross to Singapore or move between Johor Bahru and the smaller towns for treatment.
regionIntro.perak: Perak's towns are spread out, and {city} is served on our same-day Peninsular run for orders before 2pm. The battery covers a full day of errands, and the folding frame fits the boot of the family car for trips to Ipoh's hospitals.
regionIntro.penang: On the island or the mainland, {city} is inside our same-day delivery area. Penang means lifts, ramps and busy pavements, and a chair that is light and folds small is the difference between going out and staying home.
regionIntro.kedah: Kedah is the far end of our same-day run, and {city} qualifies for orders placed before 2pm. Rural roads and larger house compounds suit the chair well — the range covers the distances a day in {city} involves.
regionIntro.perlis: Perlis is small enough that {city} is never far from the main road, and orders before 2pm reach it the same day. Most enquiries here are for elderly parents at home, where a reclining backrest and a simple joystick matter most.
regionIntro.kelantan: Kelantan is part of our same-day Peninsular area, and {city} is on the route for orders placed before 2pm. Wide house compounds and flat ground make the chair easy to use outdoors as well as in.
regionIntro.terengganu: Along the coast in {city}, deliveries follow the same rule as the rest of the Peninsula: order before 2pm, receive it the same day. The chair is set up on arrival and shown to whoever will be using it.
regionIntro.pahang: Pahang covers a lot of ground, and {city} is served on our same-day run when the order is in before 2pm. For hillier towns, the motor and the joystick's low-speed setting make slopes and ramps manageable.
regionIntro.sabah: Sabah is 2–3 business days from us, and {city} receives the chair assembled and ready to drive. Once it arrives, the range and the folding frame suit the long distances and the mix of town and rural roads across the state.
